objective: Recover measured F16 HC down decode cost without changing original weight format. Overall Q2 must match UD; this is one component, not reduced acceptance scope.

numerical_policy: Report exact replay and all frontier drift; owner permits performance exploration before numerical correction. No promotion on throughput alone.
microbenchmark: Rotate 16 distinct 6.55MB matrices beyond MALL cache; same original F16 input layout; HIP event wall GPU latency, warmup plus 5 batches of 128 launches. Microbench is not model throughput.
thermal_policy: Fresh admission requires AMD CPU and GPU sensors; stop only owned process group at 85C or lower exposed max/crit threshold. Thermal abort is not a numerical failure.

model_screen: If microbenchmark improves, run matched original Q2, four-wave Q2 and pristine UD C1 pp2048/tg128: one warmup plus three measured sessions, original model/inputs, MTP off. This bounded diagnostic does not narrow the overall parity goal or qualify long context. No profiler inside timings.
build_scope: HC microbenchmark compiles the original kernels.hip.cpp translation unit plus its original w8a8_wave64 link dependency, with compile options inherited from the upstream numerical target and the original wave64 flag. No unrelated MMQ/executor compilation. Full-model benchmarks still link the complete original numerical target.
model_build_policy: One compiler job per model arm to reduce CPU build heat; identical compiler/numerical flags and runtime policy. Stop at 85C, no automatic restart.
mmq_reuse: Bounded 2K model arms reuse the unchanged MMQ archive from task-owned qualified q2-explore-reference-r1 or q2-explore-ud-r1. Verify all 1019 source files, permitting only kernels.hip.cpp to differ; verify prior model binary SHA and record/cross-check archive SHA before/after. model_cooldown: All three matched bench2k arms use an explicit 15s idle interval before the warmup and before each measured independent session, outside PP/TG timing. Report wall duration separately. This measures isolated warm-model requests, not continuous serving throughput. Motivated by retained uncooled reference abort CPU85.750C after one measured sample; no thermal guard is relaxed.
